speaker: Unknown
en: I'm Mike Allen with Behind the Curtain, today from Fort Worth, Texas, where we're talking to Jensen Wong, CEO of NVIDIA, the most valuable company in the world, about what's next for the AI revolution.
zh: 我是 Mike Allen，来自《幕后》节目，今天在德克萨斯州沃斯堡，我们要采访的是 Jensen Wong，NVIDIA 的 CEO，这家公司是世界上最有价值的公司，我们要聊聊 AI 革命的下一步是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jensen Wong, co-founder and CEO from DayZero of NVIDIA, the most valuable company in the world.
zh: Jensen Wong，NVIDIA 的联合创始人兼 CEO，从 DayZero 开始任职，这家公司是世界上最有价值的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks for sitting down with Axios.
zh: 感谢你接受 Axios 的采访。

speaker: Unknown
en: Behind the Curtain.
zh: 《幕后》。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm delighted to do it, Mike.
zh: 我很乐意这样做，Mike。

speaker: Unknown
en: Great to see you.
zh: 很高兴见到你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Axios always starts with the news.
zh: Axios 总是从新闻开始说起。

speaker: Unknown
en: The Financial Times says Chinese regulators are looking at export controls, tightening their controls on AI models and semiconductors to keep them away from the West.
zh: 《金融时报》表示，中国监管机构正在考虑出口管制，收紧对 AI 模型和半导体的控制，以防止它们流向西方。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think that will happen?
zh: 你认为这会发生吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And what would the net effect on the U.S. be?
zh: 这对美国的净影响会是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I hope not.
zh: 我希望不会。

speaker: Unknown
en: The Chinese market, the Chinese industry creates some really great AI models and AI technology.
zh: 中国市场，中国产业创造了一些真正优秀的 AI 模型和 AI 技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've said before that half of the world's AI researchers are Chinese.
zh: 我以前说过，世界上有一半的 AI 研究人员是中国人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Many of them still live in China.
zh: 他们中的许多人仍住在中国。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they produce some really groundbreaking research in AI.
zh: 他们在 AI 方面产出了一些真正开创性的研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the United States does too, and many places around the world does.
zh: 美国也是如此，世界各地的许多地方也是如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we want to make sure that we can all share ideas as broadly and as quickly as possible so that we can advance this incredible technology in a way that's beneficial to society, safely, so on.
zh: 我们要确保我们都能尽可能广泛、尽可能快地分享想法，这样我们就能以一种对社会有益的方式推进这项不可思议的技术，安全地推进等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I hope that they continue to keep it open.
zh: 因此我希望他们继续保持开放。

speaker: Unknown
en: You were just in China a couple of months ago.
zh: 你几个月前刚去过中国。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think they will?
zh: 你认为他们会这样做吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the likelihood?
zh: 可能性有多大？

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know the source of that news.
zh: 我不知道那条新闻的来源。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's, of course, all kinds of regulation being discussed and export control is being discussed on both sides of the ocean.
zh: 当然，大西洋两岸都在讨论各种监管措施，出口管制也在讨论之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, once one side decides to exercise export controls, everybody decides to think about export controls.
zh: 而且，你知道，一旦一方决定实施出口管制，大家都会开始考虑出口管制。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think we all ought to deescalate and let the technology advance.
zh: 我认为我们都应该缓和局势，让技术进步。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, the companies in the United States are very, very capable.
zh: 而且，你知道，美国公司的能力非常非常强。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're able to move very quickly.
zh: 我们能够行动得非常迅速。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have every confidence that the United States will continue to lead.
zh: 我完全相信美国将继续保持领先。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so long as we have the support and the encouragement of governments, we should be able to continue to do so.
zh: 只要我们有政府的支持和鼓励，我们应该能够继续这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Flip side, should the government ban or restrict Kimmy or other Chinese models?
zh: 另一方面，政府应该禁止或限制 Kimmy 或其他中国模型吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I hope not, and I really don't think so.
zh: 我希望不会，我真的认为不会。

speaker: Unknown
en: The United States, the world needs open and closed models.
zh: 美国，世界需要开放和封闭的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should use closed models because they're great to use.
zh: 我们应该使用封闭模型，因为它们很好用。

speaker: Unknown
en: They work incredibly well, Anthropic and OpenAI.
zh: 它们运作得极好，Anthropic 和 OpenAI。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are incredibly great services.
zh: 这些都是非常棒的服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should use closed models as much as we can, rent everything we can.
zh: 我们应该尽可能多地使用封闭模型，尽可能租用一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: However,
zh: 然而，

speaker: Unknown
en: The industry still needs open models.
zh: 行业仍然需要开放模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Science needs open models.
zh: 科学需要开放模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cybersecurity needs open models because it's safe.
zh: 网络安全需要开放模型，因为它是安全的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's important for cybersecurity.
zh: 这对网络安全很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's important for national security.
zh: 这对国家安全很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's important for economic security.
zh: 这对经济安全很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so companies need to be able to control some of the IP and some of the data that they have so that they could advance the AI models in a controlled way.
zh: 因此，公司需要能够控制他们拥有的一些知识产权和一些数据，以便他们能够以受控的方式推进 AI 模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: cybersecurity with the benefit of transparency, the ability for the entire community to inspect and test to make sure that we harden it in the best possible way, it's best for cybersecurity.
zh: 网络安全得益于透明度，整个社区进行检查和测试以确保我们以最佳方式加固它的能力，这对网络安全是最好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, irrespective of how many industries, open models is foundational to the advance of science and the advancement of computer science today.
zh: 因此，无论多少行业，开放模型是科学进步和今天计算机科学进步的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really do hope that we keep it open.
zh: 我真的希望我们保持开放。

speaker: Unknown
en: Simple question on the front page of The Wall Street Journal.
zh: 《华尔街日报》头版的一个简单问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Should American companies be allowed to use Chinese AI models?
zh: 美国公司应该被允许使用中国 AI 模型吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Absolutely.
zh: 绝对应该。

speaker: Unknown
en: Absolutely.
zh: 绝对应该。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a misconception that somehow there are backdoors that is somehow connected to China in some way.
zh: 有一种误解，认为以某种方式存在后门，并以某种方式与中国相关联。

speaker: Unknown
en: You download the models.
zh: 你下载这些模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could fine-tune it.
zh: 你可以微调它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can enhance it.
zh: 你可以增强它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can guardrail it as you desire.
zh: 你可以按照你的意愿为它加装护栏。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so these models don't just operate.
zh: 所以这些模型不仅仅是单独运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: They operate within what is called a harness.
zh: 它们在所谓的工具束中运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that harness sits within what is called essentially a sandbox.
zh: 而该工具束位于所谓的本质上沙箱之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: These sandboxes are secure.
zh: 这些沙箱是安全的。

speaker: Unknown
en: These sandboxes keeps privacy and security and access control.
zh: 这些沙箱保持隐私、安全和访问控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so all of that capability is put into the sandbox.
zh: 因此所有这些能力都被放入沙箱中。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think these models are capable models, excellent models, advances the whole industry.
zh: 所以我认为这些模型是有能力的模型，优秀的模型，推动了整个行业的发展。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we want AI to diffuse into the market as quickly as possible.
zh: 我们希望 AI 尽快扩散到市场中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so open models allows for that.
zh: 因此开放模型允许了这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can intervention by the government ever be a good thing?
zh: 政府的干预曾经是一件好事吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, regulation is a good thing in many different industries, and you want to regulate applications.
zh: 当然，在许多不同行业中监管是一件好事，并且你需要监管应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to be mindful to regulate technology.
zh: 在监管技术方面你必须保持谨慎。

speaker: Unknown
en: The raw technology itself is dual use, and so we want to make sure that you regulate how it's used.
zh: 原始技术本身是双用途的，因此我们要确保你监管它的使用方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe you want to regulate the service itself.
zh: 也许你想监管服务本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe you'll regulate how it's used in medicine, how it's used in transportation.
zh: 也许你会监管它在医学中的使用方式，它在交通中的使用方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should regulate how AI is used in autonomous vehicles.
zh: 你应该监管 AI 在自动驾驶车辆中的使用方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so all these different applications of AI should be regulated.
zh: 因此所有这些不同的 AI 应用都应该受到监管。

speaker: Unknown
en: However, the technology itself ought to be able to advance as quickly as possible.
zh: 然而，技术本身应该能够尽可能快地发展。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, you've said China is an adversary in AI.
zh: 现在，你说过中国是 AI 方面的对手。

speaker: Unknown
en: What should the rules of engagement be for the U.S. with an AI adversary?
zh: 美国对于 AI 对手的交战规则应该是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, the first thing is to recognize that AI has dual use, and we want to advance it as quickly as possible because the technology, when it's advanced, is more safe, it's more secure because it works better.
zh: 嗯，首要之事是认识到 AI 具有双重用途，我们希望它尽可能快地发展，因为当这项技术进步时，它更安全、更安全，因为它运作得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: However, we want to make sure that the...
zh: 然而，我们要确保……

speaker: Unknown
en: the researchers in all of these, in all the countries are able to dialogue, cooperate whenever possible so that we can advance the technology safely.
zh: 所有这些国家的研究人员都能够对话，并在可能的情况下合作，以便我们能够安全地推进技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think an open dialogue is really important and that should be foundational.
zh: 我认为开放的对话真的很重要，这应该是基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your stock price depends partly on sales to China.
zh: 你的股价部分取决于对中国的销售。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why should we trust what you say about China and the market?
zh: 为什么我们应该相信你关于中国和市场的说法？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, we should start with the fact that our China sales is approximately zero today.
zh: 嗯，我们应该从这一事实开始，即我们目前在中国的销售额大约为零。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've told all of our investors not to expect any China sales.
zh: 而且我已经告诉我们所有的投资者，不要指望任何中国市场的销售。

speaker: Unknown
en: If both United States and United States has already licensed it, if the Chinese government and the Chinese market would like us to return, it would be a great honor to be able to support the customers and the market.
zh: 如果美国和美国已经许可了它，如果中国政府和中国市场希望我们回归，能够支持客户和市场将是莫大的荣幸。

speaker: Unknown
en: And good for business.
zh: 这对业务有好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: And great for business.
zh: 这对业务大有好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: But until then, I would just assume that the sales is zero.
zh: 但在此之前，我就假设销售额为零。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's Kimi policy.
zh: 这就是 Kimi 的政策。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, Kimi, the very powerful Chinese model that really rattled the stock market.
zh: 现在，Kimi，那个非常强大的中国模型，真的震撼了股市。

speaker: Unknown
en: Microsoft is using and testing Kimi.
zh: 微软正在使用和测试 Kimi。

speaker: Unknown
en: The information says Chinese models may even replace some of Microsoft's use of open AI andthropic.
zh: 信息显示，中国模型甚至可能取代微软对 open AI 和thropic 的一些使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this Chinese competition is coming fast and furious.
zh: 所以这种中国的竞争来得既快又猛。

speaker: Unknown
en: What should USAI companies do?
zh: USAI 公司应该做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: These Chinese models are excellent.
zh: 这些中国模型很优秀。

speaker: Unknown
en: Open source models that are excellent should be used.
zh: 应该使用优秀的开源模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the market's misunderstood the impact of DeepSeek the first time.
zh: 因此市场第一次误解了 DeepSeek 的影响。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another Chinese model.
zh: 另一个中国模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, it's misunderstood the impact of Kimmy again this time.
zh: 是的，这次它又误解了 Kimmy 的影响。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think, first of all, with great AI...
zh: 我认为，首先，拥有伟大的 AI……

speaker: Unknown
en: Open models.
zh: 开放模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's great for the whole industry.
zh: 这对整个行业来说都是好事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Obviously, when there's more, if there's great AI, even if it's open, wherever it comes from, there will be more use.
zh: 显然，当有更多，如果有伟大的 AI，即使是开放的，无论它来自哪里，都会有更多的使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Whenever there's more use, you'll have to sell a lot more NVIDIA computers.
zh: 每当有更多的使用，你就必须卖出多得多的 NVIDIA 电脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll have to build more data centers.
zh: 我们将必须建造更多的数据中心。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll have more services.
zh: 我们将有更多的服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: The technology will diffuse into more industries.
zh: 技术将扩散到更多的行业。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so...
zh: 所以……

speaker: Unknown
en: Starting point is great models lead to great use, which leads to great growth.
zh: 起点是伟大的模型带来伟大的使用，从而带来巨大的增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's just the starting point.
zh: 所以那只是起点。

speaker: Unknown
en: That happened with DeepSeek.
zh: 这在 DeepSeek 上发生了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's going to happen with Kimmy.
zh: 它也将在 Kimmy 上发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's also a misunderstanding that open models could be adversarial to the closed models.
zh: 还有一种误解，认为开放模型可能对封闭模型不利。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's also got it wrong.
zh: 这也搞错了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason for that is because...
zh: 原因是因为……

speaker: Unknown
en: The most likely person to upgrade to a great model like Anthropic and OpenAI is someone who already uses AI.
zh: 最有可能升级到像 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 这样伟大的模型的人，是那些已经在使用 AI 的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they would like to have it more conveniently.
zh: 并且他们想更方便地拥有它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe they'd like to have more services come along with Anthropic and OpenAI.
zh: 也许他们想要 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 提供更多的服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe the models are just so much better, which I expect it to be.
zh: 也许这些模型要好得多，这也是我所预期的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so...
zh: 所以……

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think that the thing that we want to do is make sure that we have AI technology diffuse into the industries as quickly as possible, have as many people use it as quickly as possible.
zh: 所以我认为我们要做的是确保我们将 AI 技术尽快扩散到各个行业，让尽可能多的人尽快使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so open models, extremely cheap models, easy on-ramps to try AI, that's the best thing we could do.
zh: 所以开放模型，极其便宜的模型，轻松尝试 AI 的途径，这是我们能做的最好的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, NVIDIA has its own open source model, Demotron.
zh: 现在，NVIDIA 有自己的开源模型，Demotron。

speaker: Unknown
en: When we were miking up, you were telling me it's at the frontier, not the frontier.
zh: 当我们正在麦克风前说话时，你告诉我它在边界，而不是边界。

speaker: Unknown
en: Will it become the dominant U.S. open source model?
zh: 它会成为占主导地位的美国开源模型吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: We built it so that companies and industries who, for sovereignty reasons, regulatory reasons, privacy reasons, very specific domain, intellectual properties reasons, would like to build their own AI.
zh: 我们构建它是为了让那些出于主权原因、监管原因、隐私原因、非常特定的领域、知识产权原因而想要构建自己 AI 的公司和行业。

speaker: Unknown
en: I advise all of my customers to use OpenAI and Anthropic and use closed models and services as much as they can.
zh: 我建议我所有的客户尽可能多地使用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 以及封闭模型和服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it's easy.
zh: 因为这很容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: It works incredibly well.
zh: 它的效果极好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I use it.
zh: 而且我也在使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I use Perplexity and Anthropic and OpenAI.
zh: 我使用 Perplexity、Anthropic 和 OpenAI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you use these services as much as you can.
zh: 并且你尽可能多地使用这些服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: You only build your own AI if you must.
zh: 只有当你必须时才构建你自己的 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it turns out a lot of companies, whether it's financial services or cybersecurity companies, companies like ourselves, we must build our own AI.
zh: 事实证明，很多公司，无论是金融服务还是网络安全公司，像我们这样的公司，我们必须构建自己的 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so Nemotron is built for companies who need to do that.
zh: 所以 Nemotron 是为那些需要这样做的公司构建的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't have to be the frontier.
zh: 我们不必是边界。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have to be at the frontier.
zh: 我们必须在边界。

speaker: Unknown
en: And how quickly could you push out the big boys or compete with the big boys at the frontier?
zh: 你能多快地挤出那些大公司或在边界上与那些大公司竞争？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not our goal.
zh: 那不是我们的目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our goal is simply if you need to build your own custom models and custom AI, we could be of service to you to help you do that.
zh: 我们的目标只是，如果你需要构建你自己的定制模型和定制 AI，我们可以为你提供服务来帮助你做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: With the right harness, these harnesses are, for example, OpenClaw or Hermes or Cloud Code, for example, is a harness around...
zh: 有了正确的挽具，这些挽具是，例如，OpenClaw 或 Hermes 或 Cloud Code，例如，就是一个挽具，围绕……

speaker: Unknown
en: the Opus AI models.
zh: Opus AI 模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the large language model is the brain, the harness, if you will, turns it into an agent and into a thinking, working agent that can help you do things.
zh: 所以大语言模型是大脑，挽具，如果你愿意的话，把它变成一个智能体，变成一个思考的、工作的智能体，可以帮助你做事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so with the right harness, NVIDIA's Nemotron is extraordinarily good.
zh: 所以有了正确的挽具，NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 非常出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you could adapt it, customize it for the certain skills that you have in mind, and it can be completely world-class.
zh: 你可以调整它，为你心中的某些技能定制它，它可以是完全世界级的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the economics for the proprietary labs if open source models, not just Chinese ones, can produce tokens, the intelligence, cheaper?
zh: 如果开源模型，不仅仅是中国的，能更便宜地生产 tokens，即智能，那么专有实验室的经济学是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Fantastic.
zh: 极好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Really, what the world needs is more people who need AI.
zh: 真的，世界需要的是更多需要 AI 的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the only way that you need AI is because you tried it and you realize you want better ones.
zh: 而你需要 AI 的唯一原因是因为你试过并且意识到你想要更好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, these free services and build-it-yourself AIs, it's not for everybody.
zh: 而且，你知道，这些免费服务和自建 AI，并不适合所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, however, once you tried it once and you realize it's so clumsy, it's so much work.
zh: 你知道，然而，一旦你试过一次并且意识到它是如此笨拙，它太费功夫了。

zh: 你可以是建筑工人、水管工、电工。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could be a scientist.
zh: 你可以是科学家。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could be an artist.
zh: 你可以是艺术家。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could create a great living.
zh: 你可以创造美好的生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I think that this is an extraordinary country.
zh: 所以我认为这是一个非凡的国家。

speaker: Unknown
en: I advise every bright mind around the world to find your way here.
zh: 我建议世界各地每个聪明的头脑想办法来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need you here.
zh: 我们需要你在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: This country was built by immigrants.
zh: 这个国家是由移民建立的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This country is going to need amazing immigrants in the future.
zh: 这个国家未来将需要出色的移民。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they're going to come here and join the amazing minds that are already here.
zh: 他们会来到这里，并加入这里已有的惊人的头脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we have 400 million amazing people who welcome the brightest minds and the greatest people in the future to come here.
zh: 所以我们有 4 亿杰出的人，欢迎未来最聪明的头脑和最优秀的人来这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't wear a watch.
zh: 你不戴手表。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at this moment, that's probably a good thing.
zh: 在这一刻，这可能是一件好事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because now is the most important time.
zh: 因为现在是最重要的时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: I refuse to let Outlook manage my life, and I refuse to let a watch manage my life.
zh: 我拒绝让 Outlook 管理我的生活，我也拒绝让手表管理我的生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I'm too late, somebody will let me know.
zh: 如果我迟到了，有人会告诉我的。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the meantime, I'm 100% here.
zh: 与此同时，我百分之百在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so now is the most important time.
zh: 所以现在是最重要的时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: One fun thing, you've said that besides work, you spend all your time with your family.
zh: 有一个有趣的事情，你说过除了工作之外，你把所有时间都花在你的家人身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take us through a Saturday with your family when you're not working.
zh: 带我们度过一个你不工作时的周六家庭时光。

speaker: Unknown
en: Perfect Saturday.
zh: 完美的周六。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wake up early.
zh: 我起得很早。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I play with the dogs.
zh: 我和狗一起玩。

speaker: Unknown
en: And shortly after, Lori walks the dogs.
zh: 之后不久，Lori 去遛狗。

speaker: Unknown
en: I start working.
zh: 我开始工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I work until lunch.
zh: 我一直工作到午餐。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have a great lunch.
zh: 我们吃了一顿很棒的午餐。

speaker: Unknown
en: The dogs are asleep.
zh: 狗睡着了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We work through to dinner and the kids come over.
zh: 我们一直工作到晚餐，孩子们过来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We make dinner together.
zh: 我们一起做晚餐。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're all together enjoying dinner, have cocktail and play with the dogs.
zh: 我们都在一起享受晚餐，喝鸡尾酒，和狗一起玩。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's a perfect day, you know?
zh: 这就是完美的一天，你知道吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so if I could have that day every weekend, well, as it turns out, every weekend is exactly like that.
zh: 所以如果我能每个周末都有这样的一天，嗯，事实证明，每个周末确实都是那样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wake up the same time, play with the dogs, hope to see the family, hope to see the kids come over.
zh: 同一时间醒来，和狗一起玩，希望能见到家人，希望能看到孩子们过来。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, that's it.
zh: 你知道，就这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the perfect day.
zh: 这就是完美的一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jensen Wan, thanks for a memorable, meaty conversation.
zh: Jensen Wan，谢谢这次难忘的、充实的对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you, Mike.
zh: 谢谢你，Mike。

speaker: Unknown
en: Great to see you.
zh: 很高兴见到你。
